$comment: market.composite@1.0.0 — source §8.5. Renormalized weighted mean. Cases chosen so the renormalized weighted mean is hand-verifiable exactly.

cases.name: all_four_present
cases.why: Weights sum to 1.00 when every component is present, so renormalization is a no-op: 0.35·0.2 + 0.30·0.5 + 0.25·(−0.2) + 0.10·1.0 = 0.07 + 0.15 − 0.05 + 0.10 = 0.27.

cases.name: two_missing_renormalized
cases.why: sector_breadth_score and sampled_retail_stance omitted entirely (not zero). news and price both equal 0.5, so the renormalized weighted mean equals 0.5 regardless of the exact renormalized weights.

cases.name: single_component
cases.why: Only price_regime present: its renormalized weight is 1, so the composite equals the component value exactly.

abstention.message: None of the four composite components (news sentiment, price regime, sector breadth, sampled retail stance) had adequate coverage this cycle. A composite with no participating component is not a smaller composite, it is no composite.
